def is_divisible(n):
    # Base case: 1 is prime
    if n == 1:
        return False
    # Digit sum and product (key)
    digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in str(n))
    product = n
    for digit in str(n):
        product *= int(digit)
    return n % digit_sum == 0 or n % product == 0
